name_en: al-Tabari (Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari)
name_orig: محمد بن جرير بن يزيد الطبري
born: not in my texts (header gives death only)
role_place: Baghdad historian and exegete; compiler of the Tarikh (Sunni)
why_relevant: Records the marriage at six (and variant seven), the Khawla/Abu Bakr/Mut'im objections, and Abu Bakr's wives and children (P01-P04).
fame: Very well known; the Tarikh is the standard early Islamic history.

name_en: Ibn Sa'd (Muhammad ibn Sa'd, Katib al-Waqidi)
role_place: Baghdad scholar; secretary to al-Waqidi; author of the Tabaqat
why_relevant: Preserves the largest set of Hisham-from-Urwa variants (6/7/9), the Zuhri 6/9/18 and the chronological note (P06-P13, P28).
fame: Well known; the Tabaqat al-kubra is a standard source.

why_relevant: Earliest explicit age (6/9/18) in a text I read (P14); early converts list calls Aisha "young" (P15).
fame: Very well known; known through recensions.

role_place: Egyptian/Basran? recension of Ibn Ishaq (place not checked)
why_relevant: Converts list ("then young", P16) and the unattributed "7 or 9 or 10" summary (P17).

died: not read in my texts (146 AH by general knowledge)
why_relevant: Origin of most age reports (6/7/9); reliability debate after his Iraq period (P07-P10, P14, P18, P21-P23).
fame: Major transmitter of hadith (Malik, Shu'ba, Sufyan students).

name_orig: شمس الدين محمد بن أحمد الذهبي
why_relevant: Quotes the Hisham/Ibn Khirash criticism and defends Hisham; computes Asma's age (P18-P21, P23, P20).
Reports Hisham on Asma at 100 (P24); glosses the "married at six" phrase (P26); reports Ibn Shubruma through Ibn Hazm (P27).
Repeats Asma at 100 in the year 73 (P25).

name_orig: محمد بن عبد الله الحاكم النيسابوري
died: not read in my texts (405 AH by general knowledge)
why_relevant: Same chain as Tabari vol. 3 p. 162 but gives 7 at marriage (P05).
Source of "Asma ten years older than Aisha" (P20) and of the 6/9 Hisham report (P07).
Says criticism of Hisham began only after his Iraq move (P22).
Reports Malik's dislike of Hisham's Iraqi narrations and the change of formula (P23).
fame: Known only as a quoted critic.

role_place: Kufan jurist (per general knowledge; not verified in texts read)
why_relevant: Holds that the marriage at six was a privilege of the Prophet and that fathers may not marry young virgins (P27).
fame: Known jurist of the Kufan tradition.
